image_prompt.text: A tall tower as the single orientation anchor, visible from anywhere on the surrounding ground
Walkable routes around and up through the tower so movement has an obvious grain
Composed vantage points on the tower levels looking out over the ground below

notes: Stage A landed on Unrecognised: avatar tower could be a tower obby, an avatar customization or display tower, or a stack of avatars. The clarifying question the rule calls for could not be asked, so this fell through to no-genre rather than guessing a genre the user never named.
Stacked verticality because a tower puts surfaces above each other, which routes P2.
If the tower is tall, one top-down frame will not hold it and the ascent should be decomposed into stacked frames.
